dialog.agent:
Veo 3 is a paid model and can’t run on your connected Free plan. I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

I won’t substitute another model. To proceed with Veo 3 only, you’d need paid-plan access; I’d then ask for your approval of the quoted **80-credit cost** before generating the widescreen clip with rain sounds.

turns.agent:
Your “go” confirms approval of the quoted 80 credits, but Veo 3 is still unavailable on your Free plan. I can’t submit a paid-only request from this account.

No credits have been spent. Upgrade to a plan with Veo access, and I can proceed without switching models.
